commands: echo ===compose-config===; docker-compose config >/tmp/compose.out 2>/tmp/compose.err; echo CONFIG_EXIT:$?; tail -n 80 /tmp/compose.out; tail -n 80 /tmp/compose.err
echo ===pull===; docker-compose pull >/tmp/pull.out 2>/tmp/pull.err; echo PULL_EXIT:$?; tail -n 120 /tmp/pull.out; tail -n 120 /tmp/pull.err
echo ===up===; docker-compose up -d --remove-orphans >/tmp/up.out 2>/tmp/up.err; echo UP_EXIT:$?; tail -n 120 /tmp/up.out; tail -n 120 /tmp/up.err
